outcome: elevated middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (MCA-PSV)
timing of examinations/admission after DFM onset
cohort: The cohort consisted of 57 individuals from the Japanese nationwide cerebral palsy registry (2009-2022) who developed fetomaternal hemorrhage (FMH) with cerebral palsy.
finding: Decreased fetal movement (DFM) was prevalent in pregnancies complicated by fetomaternal hemorrhage (FMH), but its management was often inadequate, leading to diagnostic delays and revealing limitations in fetal heart rate monitoring and MCA-PSV evaluations.
